title: Career Roadmap · EV Service Technician
summary: An Electric Vehicle (EV) Service Technician inspects, diagnoses, maintains and repairs electric vehicles, including their motors, batteries, charging systems and electrical controls.

facts.Course: Diploma - Renewable Energy / EV Technology / Solar

about.label: Common pathway
about.text: Class 10/12 → ITI / Automotive or EV diploma → supervised workshop training → EV Service Technician → Senior Technician / EV Diagnostic Specialist.

blocks.label: Stream
blocks.text: Science with Mathematics is useful; vocational pathways may accept other qualifications.

blocks.label: Useful subjects
blocks.text: Physics, Mathematics, basic electronics and computer applications.

blocks.label: Explore
blocks.text: Electric motors, batteries, vehicle systems, charging equipment and diagnostics.

blocks.label: Early skills
blocks.text: Tool handling, logical troubleshooting, safety awareness and attention to detail.

blocks.label: Training route
blocks.text: Explore ITI automotive/electrical trades, polytechnic diplomas and recognized EV skill courses. Verify current eligibility.

items.text: ITI Electrician / Mechanic Electric Vehicle (where offered) → Electrical and EV maintenance fundamentals.
Diploma in Automobile Engineering → Vehicle servicing, diagnostics and maintenance.
Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering → Motors, wiring, controllers and power electronics.
Diploma / certificate in EV Technology → EV systems, batteries and charging technology.
B.Tech. in Automobile, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering → Advanced diagnostics, testing and engineering roles.

blocks.label: Admission
blocks.text: ITI, polytechnic and degree eligibility varies by course and state. Verify current official admission notifications and the exact trade title.

blocks.label: Year 1
blocks.text: Automotive fundamentals, electrical safety, tools, batteries and motor basics.

blocks.label: Year 2
blocks.text: EV diagnostics, wiring diagrams, controllers, charging systems and workshop practice.

blocks.label: Year 3 / work experience
blocks.text: Fault diagnosis, preventive maintenance, service records and supervised repair work.

blocks.label: Project ideas
blocks.text: EV component identification chart; simulated diagnostic report; battery-health data analysis using training data; EV service checklist.

blocks.label: Government / training
blocks.text: Government ITIs, NSTIs, DGT-supported EV labs and recognized automotive skill centres.

blocks.label: Private sector
blocks.text: EV dealerships, authorized service centres, fleet-maintenance companies and battery-service providers.

blocks.label: Potential employers
blocks.text: Tata Motors, Mahindra, TVS, Ather Energy and other EV manufacturers or service networks; check official career pages.

blocks.label: Ideal areas
blocks.text: Workshop maintenance, diagnostics, battery systems, motor controllers and charging equipment.
The Automotive Skills Development Council (ASDC) publishes EV technician training resources and qualification information. Check its current training-centre directory for available programmes.
ASDC
Internships and job placements are not guaranteed.

blocks.label: Advanced route
blocks.text: Diploma / engineering degree → EV Testing, Battery Systems or Automotive Engineering roles.

blocks.label: Alternative
blocks.text: EV service training → fleet maintenance, charging infrastructure or battery service, with additional training.
Relevant further study

Diploma in Electrical / Electronics Engineering.

B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, Mechanical or Automobile Engineering.

blocks.text: Two-wheeler EVs, four-wheeler EVs, battery systems, motor controllers, diagnostics, charging infrastructure and fleet maintenance.

Technical skills

items.text: Electrical and high-voltage safety
EV battery, motor and controller fundamentals
Wiring diagrams and diagnostic procedures
Charging-system inspection

blocks.text: Tools / technologies

items.text: Digital multimeter and automotive diagnostic scanner
Insulated tools and appropriate personal protective equipment
EV service manuals and diagnostic software
Battery-management-system monitoring tools
Workshop service and inventory systems

blocks.text: Useful certifications / training

items.text:
ASDC Electric Vehicle Service Technician qualification, subject to current recognition and availability.
National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC)
+1

EV high-voltage safety training.
Manufacturer-authorized EV service training.

blocks.text: Certification titles and qualification status can change. Verify current details with ASDC or the relevant training provider. Never service high-voltage components without the required training, isolation procedures and supervision.

blocks.label: Countries to explore
blocks.text: Germany, Australia, Canada, UK and New Zealand.
Institutions / training routes to investigate

items.text: Germany — technical universities and vocational institutions offering automotive or electrical engineering.
Australia — TAFE providers offering automotive electrical or EV-related training.
Canada — colleges offering Automotive Service Technician or Electrical Engineering Technology programmes.
UK — colleges offering vehicle maintenance, automotive engineering or EV-related qualifications.
New Zealand — polytechnics offering automotive engineering and vehicle-service training.

blocks.text: Common admission requirements

items.text: Academic records and course-specific prerequisites.
Relevant mathematics, science or mechanical background for some programmes.
English or local-language proficiency where required.
Passport, financial evidence and applicable student-visa documents.
Local licensing or trade recognition may be required for some jobs.

blocks.text: Verify exact programme names, practical training, recognition, fees and visa rules through official institution websites.
